scope: 28 forms: all action/reference/portrait, actual UNIT_BIRTH_ART overrides and fallback baked sources, scene layers, held-hurt priority, ranged fallback and raw provenance. Birth/death/hurt visual approval pending.

runtimePrecedence.rule: UNIT_BIRTH_ART[key] overrides authored actions.birth when agent.birth is active; scene layer failures retain baked atlas fallback.
Combinations excluded; no legacy visual attributes; bilateral side index=pose.frame+(sourceSide>0?times.length:0). Flip each cell AND exchange side blocks to preserve actual struck side.
Secretion-only/stat-only ranged fallback includes own attack, idle, walk, hurt, lifecycle, projectile. Higher-priority blade/carapace/antenna/feet/strength/arms excludes fallback.

safetyRules: No mutation authorized. Visual family candidate is not approval for all actions.
Never overwrite a source used by preserved/noncandidate forms. Use proposed same-directory filename and change only selected references later.
SHA-filename scene layers require new content-addressed names, even if all users selected.
Mirror scene destinations in parent canvas coordinates as parentWidth-x-width; mirror scene anchors/pivots/polygons separately; layer cells retain independent dimensions.
Unknown grid or conflicting geometry blocks transformation. Raw source packing requires original exact crop/resize/translation reconstruction.
Preserve timing, frame order, transparency and dimensions. Bilateral hurt block permutation is an explicit semantic exception, not a whole-sheet flip.
External metadata references are inventoried but not all prove ownership; review before mutation.
